Fenster, die live aufgehen und kippen, R: Windows that open and tilt live, blinds that move along – today we add the windows.
Mit jedem Fensterstil, jeder Sensor-Art: With every window style, every sensor type and the blind position sensor.
Teil 3: Die Türen sind drin – jetzt komm: Part 3: the doors are in – now come the windows, with contacts, handle and tilt sensors, and blinds.
Rechts läuft wieder „3D daneben“ mit, un: On the right, “3D beside” – „3D daneben“ – runs along again, and like in part 2, contacts and blinds come from the room's area.
„Tür & Fenster“ und auf die Außenwand vo: “Doors & windows”, „Tür & Fenster“, and tap the outer wall of the living room. At first it becomes a front door – so pick “Double window” at the top, „Fenster 2-flügelig“.
Fenster haben zusätzlich die „Brüstung“:: Windows also have the “Sill height”, „Brüstung“: the height of the lower edge above the floor. Plus “Width”, “Centre from corner” and “Height”, just like the doors.
Unter „Stil“: Standard, mit Sprossen ode: Under “Style”: standard, with glazing bars, or a fixed glass wall.
Der „Rollladen“ ist schon gefunden: „Aut: The “Blind”, „Rollladen“, has already been found: “Automatic (Wohnzimmer Rollladen)”. With two leaves, each leaf has its own sensors – main leaf and second leaf.
Beim Kontakt steht „Automatisch (Terrass: The contact says “Automatic (Terrassentür)” – the first contact in the living room. But this window doesn't have one: “None”.
Die Küche bekommt ein Fenster mit Spross: The kitchen gets a window with glazing bars: tap the wall, “Window” at the top, style “With glazing bars”, „Mit Sprossen“. The bars divide the glass into small panes.
Kontakt und Rollladen findet NeonPlan im: NeonPlan finds the contact and the blind in the kitchen area by itself. In the demo the window is open – it stands open in 3D and glows warm.
Im Bad sitzt das Fenster höher: 80 Zenti: In the bathroom the window sits higher: 80 centimetres wide, sill at 1.3 metres, height 0.8. That way nobody can look in from outside.
Zur Terrasse kommt eine zweiflügelige Te: Towards the terrace there's a two-leaf terrace door – “French doors” – which is basically a window with a sill height of zero.
Ihre Kontakte wähle ich von Hand: Der Ha: I pick its contacts by hand: the main leaf gets “Terrassentür”, the second leaf the “Standflügel”, the fixed leaf.
Jetzt geht in 3D der Hauptflügel auf – u: Now the main leaf opens in 3D – and with the second contact, the fixed leaf too.
Und links die Glaswand: auf die Wand, ob: And on the left, the glass wall: tap the wall, “Glass wall” at the top, „Glaswand“. Fixed, floor to ceiling, no leaves – you set width and height freely.
Jetzt das Schlafzimmer. Das Werkzeug hat: Now the bedroom. The tool remembered the glass wall – so “Window” at the top, width 1.40.
Wichtig ist die „Sensor-Art“. Ein Fenste: The important part is the “Sensor type”, „Sensor-Art“. A window contact only reports open or closed – that's the default.
Ein „Griff-Sensor“ meldet offen, gekippt: A “Handle sensor” reports open, tilted and closed – that's a window handle with three positions. I choose “Schlafzimmer Fenstergriff”.
Gekippt kippt der Flügel in 3D, offen ge: Tilted tilts the leaf in 3D, open opens it – and closed is closed.
Die dritte Art: „Kontakt + Kipp-Sensor“: The third type: “Contact + tilt sensor” – a normal contact plus a second sensor that only reports “tilted”.
Optional liefert ein „Kippwinkel-Sensor“: Optionally, a “Tilt angle sensor” provides the angle in degrees. Then the leaf tilts exactly that far – with fields for the “fully tilted” angle, an offset and the counting direction.
Gekippt zählt übrigens auch für die Warn: By the way, tilted also counts for the “Window open in the rain” warning. With the “Weather outside” extension you'll even see the rain at the house.
Zurück zum Wohnzimmerfenster: Der Rollla: Back to the living room window: the blind moves in 3D with its position from Home Assistant.
Meldet dein Rollladen die Position über: If your blind reports its position through a separate sensor in percent, pick it under “Position sensor”. Then it moves live while it's travelling.
Zählt der Sensor andersherum, hilft „Sen: If the sensor counts the other way round, “Sensor counts the other way round” fixes that. And you already know “Ask before switching” from the garage door.
Auch vor Türen fährt ein Rollladen: Bei: Blinds work in front of doors too: on the terrace door the field is called “Blind”, on the front door and the sliding door “Drive”.
And now the whole house: click “3D” at the top.
Offene Fenster und Türen leuchten warm,: Open windows and doors glow warm, tilted ones tilt, blinds and the garage door move along – all live from Home Assistant.
Und die Badtür leuchtet, solange sie zu: And the bathroom door glows as long as it's shut – exactly as we set it in part 2.
